overview.title: Wind, Sand and a Wide Atlantic Arc
overview.p1: Essaouira’s beach stretches south of the medina in a broad arc of firm sand. The water is Atlantic-cold; the wind is almost constant. This is a beach for movement — walking, kitesurf, photos — more than for still sunbathing.
overview.p2: Schools rent gear and teach beginners along the bay. Camel and horse rides appear near the shore; always agree duration and price before you mount.
overview.p3: Sunset looking back at the ramparts is one of the town’s classic images. Carry a jacket even in July.

q1.question: Is swimming safe?
q1.answer: Conditions change with swell and current. Prefer supervised zones and local advice.

q2.question: Can beginners kitesurf?
q2.answer: Yes — Essaouira is a known school destination; book a licensed centre.

q3.question: Are camel prices fixed?
q3.answer: No. Agree the route and price clearly before starting.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Essaouira Beach?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and local context.

q5.question: Is Essaouira Beach suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with normal supervision near drops, wind or busy lanes.
